binary.role: historical Windows controller, distinct from current cemsusbregsiter path

control_flow.observation: Try sub_10011530 new label first; only on failure call sub_1000f520 old LBA7 reader.
On successful old read call sub_10010850, converting three 0x40 entries into 0x60 runtime entries; set runtime version 0x64.
Select first matching partition type from three runtime entries, stride 0x60.
Copy selected entry NeedEncrypt +0x14, StartSector +0x18, PartitionSize +0x28, key CRC +0x34, and mode +0x58 to mount parameters.
Call dynamically resolved EdpMountFile with constructed mount parameters.

legacy_driver_branch.read_dispatch: EdpEDisk64.sys.m loc_124e0: version != 0x206 calls sub_13160 with 8-byte key
legacy_driver_branch.write_dispatch: EdpEDisk64.sys.m loc_12208: version != 0x206 calls sub_13450 with 8-byte key

legacy_key8_driver_probe.method: Unicorn x64, EdpEDisk64.sys sub_13160 followed by sub_13450, input/output in the same buffer as in the driver call sites
legacy_key8_driver_probe.validated_roundtrip: 16-byte zero block and both complete 3072-byte samples re-encrypt byte-for-byte to their starting ciphertext
legacy_key8_driver_probe.interpretation: The simple legacy key8 driver transform did not expose an ordinary filesystem or known label structure. This does not establish the true payload format or purpose.

proves: The historical controller can submit a legacy LBA7 LBA7 legacy compatibility extent entry as a 3072-byte virtual-disk backing extent if its new-label read fails and login reaches mount.
The normal new-label route for this disk selects a physically different type4 partition and encryption mode.
does_not_prove: That a real login on the captured disk took the legacy fallback or successfully mounted its 3072-byte extent.
That the LBA7 legacy compatibility extent payload is a recognized filesystem, credential store, key store, or IIR.
How LBA7 legacy compatibility extent is written or how its plaintext is decoded.
